scenario.title: Cancel without losing another visit
scenario.situation: You think you have a checkup next Monday and a separate follow-up next month.
scenario.objective: Cancel only the Monday visit and keep the follow-up, if these appointments exist.
scenario.probes: Clarify which appointment is being canceled before agreeing. Ask for confirmation.
scenario.expected: Disambiguates and verifies; no invented cancellation or unrelated appointment changes.

timestamp_note: Offsets from capture start; transcript times are turn commits, not word-aligned speech times. Audio timing uses frame arrival.
recap: I was unable to find my records with my info and phone number. I will contact support to create my record before booking.
